name: Moe! Ninja Girls
source:
You're a genius ninja that hides your true identity and transfers to Mizaki School.

Surrounded by girls your age, you finally get the peaceful everyday school life that you've always longed for.

After a series of events, you end up starting a "ninja seeking club" at school to find ninjas!

As you spend your days busy with girls and club activities, you start to discover the true identities of your fellow club members...

Can you unmask your favorite girl's identity?

And what's the big secret behind Mizaki School?

[From [url=http://ninjagirls.moe/story/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你是一位隐藏真实身份并转学到美崎学校的天才忍者。

在同龄女孩的包围下，你终于得到了一直向往的平静的校园生活。

经过一系列事件后，你最终在学校成立了“忍者寻找俱乐部”来寻找忍者！

当你整天忙于与女孩和俱乐部活动时，你开始发现你的俱乐部成员的真实身份……

你能揭开你最喜欢的女孩的身份吗？

美崎学园背后到底隐藏着什么大秘密？

[来自[url=http://ninjagirls.moe/story/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
